## What's changed

- Added the Apple TV playback capability contract used to select HDR output by connected-display support and Dolby Vision profile.
- Added standards-compatible fragmented MP4 HLS packaging for HEVC, including authenticated initialization and media segments.
- Preserved compatible HDR10, HLG, and Dolby Vision Profile 5 playback paths without unnecessary video conversion.
- Added safe HDR10/HLG fallback for compatible Dolby Vision Profile 8 media and HDR10 fallback for HDR10+ media.
- Added explicit SDR tone mapping when an HDR source must be converted to H.264 or uses a Dolby Vision profile the Apple TV playback path cannot safely preserve.
- Kept the existing Steam and retro-player playback behavior unchanged through capability-scoped negotiation.
